title: Dover Elevator Maintenance
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE FINANCE AND ACCOUNTING SERVICE (DFAS).DEFENSE FINANCE AND ACCOUNTING SVC
description_text: The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, materials, tools, supervision, facilities, and transportation necessary to provide elevator preventative and predictive maintenance services as defined in this Statement of Work (SOW) for DFAS-ROME, 325Brooks Road, Griffiss Business & Technology Park, Rome, NY 13441. Thecontractor shall perform to the standards in this contract, in accordance withthe manufacturer's specifications and all applicable Municipal, State, and Federal Regulations.
